headline: Jeon Woong makes solo debut Nov 30
sub: AB6IX's main vocalist goes solo 7 years after group debut
source: Source: Brand New Music via Korean media
caption:
Jeon Woong, who debuted with AB6IX in 2019, makes his official solo debut on Nov 30.

His first solo single '문득 (Mundeuk)', meaning 'suddenly', drops at 6 PM KST. It's a pop ballad about memories and longing that surface out of nowhere in everyday life, carried by warm vocals and gentle guitar.
